paragraphs: R' Pinchas bar Zakai. Mentioned in Mo'ed Katan, chapter 2, halakhah 1.[^1][^2]

notes.text: מו״ק פ״ב ה״א is expanded as Mo’ed Katan, chapter 2, halakhah 1. The format suggests the Jerusalem Talmud, but that identification is not explicit here. The supplied name is זכאי; earlier machine OCR had זבהי. The abbreviated title remains R'.
This renders Hyman’s supplied citation; its occurrence and edition-specific locator have not been independently checked.
